session.title: We need a customer self-service portal for an insurer, built…
session.input_text: We need a customer self-service portal for an insurer, built by a .NET team on Azure.

brief.summary: A customer self-service portal for an insurer.

nfrs.text: Pages load in under two seconds

options.name: Microsoft Azure
options.description: BISTEC primary platform. Default for all enterprise and client-facing projects. Compute preference: Azure Container Apps, then App Service, then AKS only when orchestration complexity is justified.

options.name: Hetzner Cloud
options.description: BISTEC budget platform. For internal tools, dev/staging environments and cost-sensitive workloads. Hetzner Cloud VMs with Docker Compose or k3s.

options.name: Azure + Hetzner (hybrid)
options.description: Production on Azure, non-production on Hetzner to reduce spend.

options.name: .NET 8+ / C#
options.description: BISTEC primary backend. Enterprise APIs, complex domain logic, high-performance services.

options.name: Node.js / TypeScript
options.description: BISTEC secondary backend. Lightweight APIs, BFF layers, real-time services, rapid prototypes.

options.name: Java or Python
options.description: Avoid for web APIs unless it is a client requirement or an ML/AI workload.

options.name: .NET 8 Minimal API
options.description: Minimal APIs for simple services; MediatR, FluentValidation, Serilog, Polly per BISTEC .NET defaults.

options.name: SQL Server
options.description: Primary RDBMS for transactional data, complex queries and reporting; Elastic Pools for many small databases.

options.name: SQLite (prod)
options.description: Avoid SQLite for production enterprise data.

options.name: Cosmos DB (SQL API)
options.description: Primary NoSQL: document storage, global distribution, flexible schema; serverless tier under 10K RU/s.

options.name: MongoDB on Hetzner
options.description: Self-hosted document database on the budget platform.

options.name: Azure AI Search
options.description: Full-text, vector and semantic ranking search.

options.name: Elasticsearch (Hetzner)
options.description: Self-hosted search on the budget platform.

options.name: SQL LIKE queries
options.description: Pattern matching in SQL; avoid for search.

options.name: Azure Blob Storage
options.description: Object storage with Hot, Cool and Archive tiering.

options.name: Hetzner Object Storage
options.description: S3-compatible object storage on the budget platform.

options.name: RabbitMQ (Hetzner)
options.description: Self-hosted broker on the budget platform.

options.name: Azure Queue (complex)
options.description: Azure Queue Storage used for complex messaging needs; avoid.

options.name: Kafka (unless scale demands)
options.description: Event streaming platform; avoid unless scale demands it.

options.name: Azure Functions
options.description: Isolated Worker on .NET 8+, Durable Functions for orchestration; consumption-based.

options.name: Entra ID
options.description: Microsoft Entra ID with OpenID Connect / OAuth 2.0; mandatory SSO for internal enterprise apps; Managed Identity for service-to-service.

options.name: GitHub Actions
options.description: BISTEC CI/CD default; GitHub (Bistec org) source control.

options.name: Docker + Container Apps
options.description: Azure Container Apps; scale to zero.

options.name: Docker + AKS
options.description: Kubernetes; only when orchestration complexity is justified.

options.name: App Insights + Azure Monitor
options.description: Application Insights with adaptive sampling, 30-day retention.

options.name: Grafana stack (Hetzner)
options.description: Grafana + Prometheus + Loki on the budget platform.
